user.title: Pool Circulation
user.description: Pick the pump speed switches, the price sensor and the two temperature sensors.

data_description.sensor_price: Needs today's hourly or 15-minute prices as an attribute (Nordpool, Tibber and similar).
data_description.daily_hours: Summer: the cheapest hours of the day run at medium speed.
data_description.temp_algae_threshold: Below this pool temperature algae don't grow, so no filtration hours are needed.
data_description.temp_freeze_threshold: At or below this outdoor temperature the pump runs continuously at low speed.

optional_devices.name: Optional devices
optional_devices.description: Leave empty if you don't have them.

data_description.switch_circulation: The speed controller's enable output, if it has one (e.g. "Inverter on/off").
data_description.climate_heat_pump: Summer only — kept on, target temperature by price. Never touched in winter.
data_description.switch_uv_lamp: On while the pump runs and the cover is not open.
data_description.cover_pool: Opening the cover starts a 5-minute high-speed burst.
data_description.sensor_pump_feedback: Measures whether the pump really turns — a power plug (W) or an rpm template. Used for runtime and to raise a fault when the pump doesn't follow the controller.

data.winter_skip_hours: Winter, cold: priciest hours to skip
data.winter_algae_hours: Winter, pool above algae threshold: hours per day
data.winter_min_hours: Winter, cold pool: minimum hours per day

data_description.pool_critical_temp: At or below this the pump runs continuously at medium, in any season.
data_description.temp_outdoor_buffer: Winter: between the frost threshold and this, run low speed most hours.
data_description.feedback_threshold: Feedback values above this count as running (W or rpm, default 10).

error.duplicate_speed_switch: Low, medium and high must be three different switches.
error.same_temperature_sensor: Pool and outdoor temperature must be different sensors.
